column1: # One row per well-known application cache directory the analyzer sizes under
# the user-caches section. Tab-separated; '#' lines are comments; the first
# non-comment line is the header and must read: label, path, category.
#   label     display name; unique; the key the plan and the report show
#   path      absolute or ~/-relative; one cache directory (removed as a whole)
#   category  app-caches         allowlisted: regenerable, SAFE, eligible for
#             app-caches-review  everything else: needs a human decision
# Every path must lie under a root of its category in share/categories.tsv
# (lib/registry.sh checks this). Source of the entries: analyze_app_specific_caches
# in lib/analyzer.sh and app_cache_auto_safe in lib/policy.sh (v3.0.7).
